items.name: video-config
items.title: Video config
items.description: The stable data contract for a renderable VanillaSky video.

vanillasky.useWhen: Use it when constructing, validating, or transforming a VideoConfig, or when a scene needs orientation-aware dimensions and safe zones.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: Do not use it for visual styling or animation; those decisions belong to theme, motion, typography, and backgrounds.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Resolve brand inputs into coherent, readable scene tokens.

vanillasky.useWhen: Use resolveTokens once per scene whenever the visual result should inherit the video's brand, preset, density, or motion intensity coherently.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: Do not hardcode fallback colors or font stacks beside it, and do not use it to animate values or paint a background.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: One deterministic progress-driven API, from raw curves to composed effects.

vanillasky.useWhen: Use it whenever a value changes with scene progress; start with a composed helper, then drop to interpolation or springs when the scene needs custom choreography.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: Do not use browser timers, CSS transitions, requestAnimationFrame, or Math.random inside a renderable scene.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Fit text to a fixed frame and give it a complete kinetic lifecycle.

vanillasky.useWhen: Use it for any text-led scene where copy must fit a known box, animate as a coherent lifecycle, or be checked against a fixed scene duration.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: Do not shrink copy indefinitely or choose an archetype without checking its allowed canvas and minimum duration.

items.name: backgrounds
items.title: Backgrounds
items.description: Paint deterministic brand backdrops and keep their visual layer moving.

vanillasky.useWhen: Use gradientBackground to paint the scene layer and getBackgroundTransform to add deterministic camera movement across the full scene duration.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: Do not apply these transforms to text or interactive chrome, and do not use CSS filter effects in the export path.
